name: corthex
description: CORTHEX: stage-by-stage AI collaboration for software projects, for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: corthex
plugins.description: Working principles, a 13-stage project workflow with one shared six-slot contract, and a profile and project registry for one person running several projects.

plugins.name: corthex-memory
plugins.description: Local redacted conversation recording, session context and memory controls for consented CORTHEX projects.

plugins.name: corthex-nexus
plugins.description: One page with the stages, checks and trace links of all your CORTHEX projects, from local files. Can send snapshots to a NEXUS server you run yourself.
